body:
3 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Heywood lollipop man forced to leap out of way as drivers ignore crossing (Heywood). A car and a moped have been seized after their drivers failed to stop for a lollipop man in Heywood, forcing him to jump aside for safety.

Police arrest 17 in operation against crime gang in Rochdale and Heywood (Rochdale). Seventeen arrests were made during a police operation targeting an organised crime group linked to violence in Heywood earlier this year.

Roadworks on Manchester Road Old Section to begin on 25 October 2026 (Rochdale). Temporary closure of part of Manchester Road Old Section in Rochdale from 25 October 2026 due to roadworks.

Weather: Cloudy 13°C in Rochdale today.
